body: Kai Cenat accidentally showed his Xbox gamertag during his GTA marathon and immediately got flooded with friend requests and messages Via: Chat wasted no time. As soon as the gamertag hit the screen, viewers went straight to Xbox to add him and send him messages. One slip and his Xbox inbox basically turned into a second stream chat Imagine trying to get back to your GTA mission while your Xbox keeps letting you know somebody else wants to be your friend.
